A variant that orchestrates parallel processing of 3D models to generate ground truth data using multiple worker processes and a queue for synchronization.
It reads object names from a list, distributes them among processes based on `idx % num_of_process`, and uses a `Queue` to collect results.

It reduces the number of disconnected components from 18,111 to 328.
